items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I was thinking about another trumpet player. It was Bobby Moore.

ctx.x: Bobby Moore, yeah. Bobby Moore. Yeah, I was thinking about another trumpet player. It was Bobby Moore.

*Rust's Jazz Records lists the following succession of trumpeters for the 1937-38 Basie band: Bobby Moore, Bobby Hicks, Karl Georne, and for a recording on February 16, 1938, Harry Edison. Phil Schaap believes Hicks is a pseudonym.
